d:
Kuchisake-Onna, the Slit-Mouthed Woman! Red coat, white surgical mask aur haath mein khooni surgical scissors liye woh sunsan sadkon par aati hai aur bas ek hi sawaal puchti hai: "Watashi Kirei? Am I Pretty?" Chahe jawaab 'Haan' ho ya 'Naa', uska anjaam sirf dardnaak maut hai. 1978 mein jab office worker Kenji Yamamoto ka saamna is aatma se hua, toh uske baad poore Japan ke schools aur sadkon par curfew jaise halaat ban gaye the.
Kya tha is kaate hue chehre ka sach? Kyun mangti hai yeh badla? Jaanne ke liye dekhiye Sannata on Discovery Channel India!
